comment: SLB 100 Family Day — single & couple mode levels with pose / face / hand detection.

intro.en:
Welcome to SLB 100 Family Day!
Complete 4 fun body-pose challenges to unlock the oil platform.

Tip: stand back so the camera sees your full upper body.
intro.zh:
欢迎来到 SLB 100 Family Day!
完成 4 个趣味身体动作挑战,解锁整个油井平台。

提示:请后退一步,让摄像头看清你的上半身。

outro.en:
Congratulations! You've completed all 4 levels.
Thank you for participating — Happy Family Day!
outro.zh:
恭喜! 你已经完成全部 4 个关卡
谢谢你的参与 — Family Day 快乐!

intro.en: Family Day is all about joy. Show us your biggest smile!
intro.zh: Family Day 充满欢乐。向我们展现你最灿烂的笑容!

task.en: Smile at the camera and hold for 2 seconds.
task.zh: 对着摄像头微笑,保持 2 秒。

intro.en: Time to flex! Raise both arms and show your strength — just like celebrating a job well done on the rig.
intro.zh: 是时候展示力量了! 举起双臂,秀出肌肉 — 就像在井场上庆祝任务完成一样。

task.en: Flex both biceps — elbows out, forearms up near shoulder height. Hold for 2 seconds.
task.zh: 弯曲手肘展示肱二头肌 — 手肘外展,小臂举至肩部高度。保持 2 秒。

title.zh: Lv3 — 双手点赞 (Double Thumbs Up)

intro.en: Give a double thumbs up to celebrate SLB 100 Family Day!
intro.zh: 用双手竖起大拇指,为 SLB 100 Family Day 点赞!

task.en: Show thumbs up with both hands at the same time. Hold for 2 seconds.
task.zh: 同时举起双手,竖起大拇指。保持 2 秒。

intro.en: SLB SAFE teaches SIPP body control for lifting. Keep a neutral spine, bend your knees, and hold the load close to your chest — the green zone.
intro.zh: SLB SAFE 的 SIPP 身体控制技巧:搬运时保持脊柱中立、弯曲膝盖,并将重物贴近胸前「绿色安全区」。

task.en: Squat with knees bent, back straight, and hands close to your chest. Hold the pose for 2 seconds.
task.zh: 弯曲膝盖、背部挺直,双手贴近胸前。保持姿势 2 秒。

hint.en: Knees bent · straight back · load at chest
hint.zh: 弯膝 · 直背 · 重物贴胸

intro.en:
Welcome to SLB 100 Family Day Couple Mode!
Team up with your partner for 4 cooperative body-pose challenges.

Tip: both players should be visible in the camera frame.
intro.zh:
欢迎来到 SLB 100 Family Day 双人模式!
和伙伴一起完成 4 个合作身体动作挑战。

提示:请确保两位玩家都在摄像头画面中。

outro.en:
Amazing! You completed all 4 levels together.
Happy Family Day!
outro.zh:
太棒了! 你们一起完成了全部 4 个关卡
Family Day 快乐!

title.zh: Lv1 — 双手点赞 (Double Thumbs Up)

intro.en: Celebrate together! Both partners show double thumbs up to start strong.
intro.zh: 一起庆祝! 两位伙伴同时双手点赞,精彩开局。

task.en: Both players show thumbs up at the same time. Hold for 2 seconds.
task.zh: 两位玩家同时竖起大拇指。保持 2 秒。

intro.en: Stand side by side. Touch your inner hands together at the center while your outer arms curve outward — forming the ∞ symbol together.
intro.zh: 并排站立。内侧手在中心相触,外侧手臂向外弯曲 — 一起组成 ∞ 符号。

task.en: Form an infinity symbol with your arms together. Inner wrists meet at center, outer arms spread out. Hold for 2 seconds.
task.zh: 用手臂一起组成无限符号 ∞。内侧手腕在中心相触,外侧手臂展开。保持 2 秒。

hint.en: Inner hands meet · outer arms out
hint.zh: 内侧手相触 · 外侧手展开

intro.en: Family Day is about connection. Give your partner a warm hug!
intro.zh: Family Day 重在联结。给伙伴一个温暖的拥抱!

task.en: Stand close and hug each other. Hold for 2 seconds.
task.zh: 靠近并拥抱彼此。保持 2 秒。

title.zh: Lv4 — 一起安全搬运 (Safe Lift Together)

intro.en: Work as a team! Both partners perform the SIPP safe-lift pose together — knees bent, straight backs, hands at chest.
intro.zh: 团队合作! 两位伙伴同时做出 SIPP 安全搬运姿势 — 弯膝、直背、双手贴胸。

task.en: Both players: squat with knees bent, back straight, hands close to chest. Hold together for 2 seconds.
task.zh: 两位玩家同时:弯膝、直背、双手贴近胸前。一起保持 2 秒。

hint.zh: 两人同时安全搬运姿势
